title: Model-specific quant tuning presets and safety checklist for catalog defaults
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Define a reproducible, auditable workflow and a set of conservative-but-usable per-model quantization presets (FP8 / INT8 / hybrid) to populate the Model Catalog's 'recommended quant profile' field. Deliverables: 1) A small set of validated presets with clear guardrails and fallback rules; 2) A calibration & validation pipeline that produces deterministic artifacts for each model; 3) Console/CLI metadata fields and gating rules to prevent accidental rollout of aggressive quant to production without human signoff.
acceptance_criteria: Five canonical presets are defined and documented (conservative-int8, latency-fp8, kv-only-int8, hybrid-fp8-int8, unquantized-safe)
Calibration pipeline produces a signed artifact containing calibration stats and representative eval metrics for each model/version
Model Catalog UI shows recommended preset + clear guardrail badges (e.g., 'requires-review' / 'low-risk')
Automated gating blocks default assignment if regression >1% abs on primary metric or NLL increases by >0.4
Nightly calibration job runs for new model uploads and attaches artifacts to the model metadata with S3 path
technical_plan: Define calibration dataset recipe: per-model blend of 10k prompts sampled across domain splits (general, code, dialogue, domain-specific) and 3 sequence length buckets (short/medium/long)
Implement calibration jobs in runner service that export: per-layer scale factors, per-token logprob deltas, KL divergence histogram between FP16 and quantized outputs, and a calibration fingerprint
Add per-model sensitivity analysis (per-layer activation and weight sensitivity) using 100-shot perturbation tests to identify layers that must remain FP16

Create three profile types: performance-optimized (FP8 bias-friendly kernels), memory-optimized (INT8 activation+weights where safe), and safety-optimized (restrict quant to embeddings & KV caches only)
Store calibration artifacts as immutable objects and surface a signed checksum in model metadata to support audits and rollbacks
Expose an API endpoint to request re-calibration with a custom dataset for customers who want tailored defaults
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal): Run calibration on top 30 public models and verify metrics; collect telemetry for 2 weeks
Phase 2 (beta): Surface presets in Model Catalog for 10% of orgs with opt-in flag; require SRE/ML owner opt-in for auto-apply
Phase 3 (gradual default): If no regressions found, promote conservative-int8 as catalog default for compatible models; aggressive presets remain behind manual enablement
Rollback policy: Automatic revert to FP16 or previous known-good profile if production metric delta exceeds thresholds or error rate increases
test_plan: Unit tests for calibration runner and artifact schema
Integration test: run calibration pipeline end-to-end against a mocked model and verify artifact attached to metadata
Regression harness: golden prompt set (200 prompts) per model that runs in CI comparing FP16 vs preset; gating if >1% EM/accuracy loss or avg logprob drop >0.5
Canary: small traffic canary for customers on dedicated infra with automatic rollback hooks
decisions: Default to conservative presets for public catalog entries; never publish aggressive perf-only presets as default
Quant artifacts must include both functional metrics and low-level calibration statistics to enable root-cause analysis
Calibration runs are deterministic — seeded and recorded inputs used so outputs reproducible
Per-layer exceptions will be encoded as 'pin-to-fp16' list in the preset schema rather than ad-hoc config
open_questions: What threshold for KL divergence should trigger human review? Proposal: KL > 0.02 averaged across token positions
How to account for hallucination/practical downstream harms in automatic gating — can we define a domain-agnostic metric?
Should we allow customer-specific defaults to override catalog defaults automatically or require explicit opt-in?
Latency SLO tradeoffs for large-context models when using FP8 kernels — how to measure end-to-end vs microbenchmarks

2025-02-18 Diego Alvarez: Implemented calibration runner prototype. Notes: KV-only INT8 works well for decoder-only models with small context but fails on long-context LLMs due to activation range overflow. Documented fallback to pin attention layers.

2025-02-25 Priya Nair (ML Research): Ran sensitivity analysis for three opensource models. Findings: middle transformer layers show highest sensitivity; recommend pin-to-fp16 default for layers 6-9 on 32-layer models.

2025-03-11 Diego Alvarez: Updated gating thresholds in CI to 1% accuracy / 0.4 NLL. Preparing PR for model-catalog to display recommended presets and guardrail badges.
